headline: Four seed batches: DonkeyKong gets replayable barrels, eleven titles start telling the truth
lede: Batches 7-10 of the seedpin rollout merged today: IronKeep and DonkeyKong now report and honor ?seed=N (40 titles replayable), and eleven more fixed-world games report {tick,score,done} honestly seedless. feedbackcheck grew 176 to 205 laws, each mutant-proven.

notes.text: Merged f8a256e, c4bc4e0, e374203, 4d6c8f0 — IronKeep, DonkeyKong report+pin; Pitfall, SimCityMin, Excitebike, LodeRunnerLite, Joust, MetroidLite, BoulderDash, Paperboy, SpyHunter, MissileBattle, ArenaArchery report seedless.

DonkeyKong is the first true seed-param port: barrel spacing and the original's ladder chance moved from raw Math.random into a shared seedRng helper, reseeded at every human start. Same template generalizes to the remaining random engines.

Audit fix: several ports flagged as 'gameplay Math.random' were only mentioning it in comments promising determinism. Every title now passes a comment-stripped zero-RNG proof, and the laws keep it true — add randomness to a fixed world without a seed and CI goes red.
Honest holds: Pong, Pacman, Frogger, Defender, Asteroids and friends have no win condition at all — they need a design pass before they can honestly report a finished run.
